name: Kujou Shizuki
source:
A first-year at Genbu Urban Prefectural Senior High School. Excellent in martial and traditional Japanese performing arts, Shizuki is a very sadistic boy from a distinguished family. Haruho met Shizuki when she was second-year junior high school student. While on a school excursion, she became lost in a traditional Japanese garden, which turned out to belong to the Kujou house.
